topic: Adaptive Modulation's Impact on Power Margins in Rural Substations
consensus_response: Adaptive modulation significantly impacts power margins in rural substations by dynamically adjusting modulation schemes and coding rates based on real-time channel conditions. This allows for efficient management of interference, improved data rates, and reduced latency, which are crucial for reliable communication in fluctuating traffic environments.  Real-world trials and open-source solutions are essential for validating the benefits and challenges of adaptive modulation.
